parameters.query:
-- Une vidéo déjà présente (même URL ou même chemin) est laissée telle quelle : l'import est rejouable.
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j),
src as (
  insert into knowledge_sources (kind, title, url, odoo_version, module, category, path, license, reliability, status, ingested_at)
  select 'youtube_video', j->>'title', j->>'url', '20.0', j->>'module', 'video', j->>'path',
    'Vidéo YouTube © Odoo S.A. (consultation personnelle, non redistribuée)', 'ai_transcript_unverified', 'ingested', now()
  from p
  on conflict do nothing
  returning id
),
ins as (
  insert into knowledge_chunks (source_id, odoo_version, module, ordinal, breadcrumb, url, anchor_verified, content, content_hash, token_count, embedding, embedding_model, start_seconds, end_seconds)
  select src.id, '20.0', c.module, c.ordinal, c.breadcrumb, c.url, true, c.content, encode(sha256(convert_to(c.content, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), c.tokens, c.embedding::vector, 'gemini-embedding-2', c.start_s, c.end_s
  from src, p, jsonb_to_recordset(p.j->'chunks') as c(module text, ordinal int, breadcrumb text, url text, content text, tokens int, embedding text, start_s int, end_s int)
  returning 1
)
select (select count(*) from src) as source_ajoutee, (select count(*) from ins) as passages

nodes.name: Already stored?
nodes.notes: Une vidéo déjà en base n'est ni résumée ni analysée à nouveau : pas de coût en double.

parameters.query: select count(*)::int as deja from knowledge_sources where path = 'youtube/' || $1
